edges.reason: msg.sender keys balances_ in transfer, caller controlled identity determines debited account
msg.sender used as spender when consuming allowed_[_from][msg.sender]

withdrawFunds relies on onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to owner
forwardFunds is guarded by onlyOwner checking msg.sender
kycPass onlyOwner compares msg.sender with CrowdsaleAddress
setKYCpassed restricted modifier compares msg.sender to owner/manager
transferOwnership onlyOwner checks msg.sender against owner
setManager onlyOwner checks msg.sender against owner
confirmOwnership requires candidate == msg.sender for ownership takeover
transferTokensFromSpecialAddress is onlyOwner gated on msg.sender

now selects presale/ICO bonus branches in _getTokenAmount

normalization_plan.reason: _owner is the lookup key consumed solely by balanceOf
_to is the recipient argument of transfer/transferFrom balance updates
_value is the amount argument flowing into SafeMath sub/add in transfer
_spender indexes the allowed_ mapping written by approve
_from is the source address debited by transferFrom
_addedValue is the amount added to the allowance by increaseApproval
_subtractedValue is the amount removed from the allowance by decreaseApproval
_account is the credited address in _mint/_burn
_amount is the minted/burned quantity manipulated with SafeMath
_beneficiary is the purchase target consumed by buyTokens
weiAmount is the msg.value copy that drives weiRaised and token computation
tokens is the computed purchase amount passed to _processPurchase
oldValue caches the allowance read in decreaseApproval
value is the scaled whole-token amount used in the balance move
bonus is the timestamp derived percentage used in the arithmetic
resultAmount accumulates the final token amount before rate multiplication
transferValue is the per-wallet share used by the ETH transfers
_investor is the whitelist subject written by kycPass
_newOwner becomes the candidate in transferOwnership
_newManager is stored into manager by setManager
